plugin.name: Venture AI Portal Advokat
plugin.description: Licensed lawyers connect to the Draft AI / Venture AI lead marketplace and desk: with a prepaid monthly or quarterly pass, browse anonymized client matters and red flags, submit proposals (up to 3 lawyers per lead), and unlock full drafts and client contacts once chosen by the client — 0% platform cut on legal fees. Taipei and Silicon Valley.

panel.m.mp.paywall.heroTitle: Draft AI / Venture AI Lead Marketplace
panel.m.mp.paywall.heroDesc: Connect directly with founders and SMEs requesting lawyer review after AI drafting. 0% platform fee on your legal billing; full files unlock once a client selects you.
panel.m.mp.paywall.gateTitle: Aktifkan pass advokat untuk mengajukan penawaran dan menangani perkara
panel.m.mp.paywall.rule1: Paket prabayar: sekali bayar, berakhir otomatis, tanpa perpanjangan otomatis.
panel.m.mp.paywall.rule2: 0% platform commission: engage the client directly and keep 100% of your legal fees.
panel.m.mp.paywall.rule3: Capped at 3 lawyers per lead: only up to 3 subscribed lawyers may submit fee proposals after viewing anonymized facts.
panel.m.mp.paywall.rule4: Select-to-unlock privacy: the client compares proposals and selects 1 lawyer, unlocking contacts and full Word/PDF drafts solely for that lawyer.
panel.m.mp.profileWarn: Complete your lawyer profile (bar registration and email) before submitting proposals.

panel.m.mp.plaza.ruleReminder: Plan B terms: clients review your bar profile, fee range, turnaround, and approach. Contacts and full drafts unlock only if the client selects you (0% platform cut).
panel.m.mp.plaza.noFacts: No additional structured facts; see red flags and screening tags.
